description: Single shared GEMSDOE24 template with documented local corrections. Pins retain upstream and local SHA-256; no alternate active evaluator.
template: GEMSDOE24 gems package (SegmentHoldout evaluator gems-segment-pooled-v1, strict writer, format validator, registry novelty)
why_this_template: GEMSDOE28 shared_template_contract names GEMSDOE24; competing GEMSDOE31 pins 57GEMSDOE. GEMSDOE24 is the locally selected canonical template, with documented patches; authority across peer sessions is unresolved.
competing_template_irregularity: GEMSDOE31 registry/shared_template.json pins a different template (57GEMSDOE@822a0ce5). Logged as IR-36-17.
known_template_issues_reported_not_forke: gems.submission.make_note enforces a 200-character limit; the owner protocol requires <= 140. GEMSDOE36 does not call make_note and enforces <= 140 in scripts/build_h36_submission.py.

Local canonical metric.py correction: isolated break-even helper must be alpha*current_DTI when alpha+beta=1; upstream alpha*s/(1-alpha*s) is not generally valid. See research/template-fixes.md. The actual DTI metric was not changed.

Local canonical novelty.py correction: fail closed for empty/undefined references, require matching CRS/transform/shape/bands, and preserve literal gating even when controls are classified diagnostically. See research/template-fixes.md.
Local canonical holdout.py correction: feature canaries fail closed on missing positives/background or non-finite AUC; no scoring/fold change. See research/template-fixes.md.

files.local_patch: Fail closed when any canary fold lacks a class or produces non-finite AUC; no DTI or fold generation change.
Correct the isolated marginal inclusion threshold to alpha*DTI when alpha+beta=1; add bounds validation. No DTI scoring changes.
Fail closed on undefined/empty supports and mismatched grids; optional control classes never waive literal pass; require template_path.
